gloss: opening a shop; setting up a stall

definitions.gloss: opening a shop, establishing a store/branch
definitions.explanation: Opening a new retail location or branch of a business. Used in business contexts for chain expansion or new store openings.

definitions.gloss: setting up a stall, having a booth
definitions.explanation: Setting up a temporary stall or booth at a market, festival, or event.

examples.japanese: {駅前|えきまえ}に{新|あたら}しいカフェが{出店|しゅってん}した。
examples.english: A new cafe opened in front of the station.

examples.japanese: あのブランドは{海外|かいがい}にも{出店|しゅってん}している。
examples.english: That brand has opened stores overseas as well.

examples.japanese: {大型|おおがた}ショッピングモールへの{出店|しゅってん}を{検討|けんとう}している。
examples.english: We are considering opening a store in a large shopping mall.

examples.japanese: フリーマーケットに{出店|しゅってん}する。
examples.english: To set up a stall at a flea market.

examples.japanese: {地元|じもと}の{祭|まつ}りに{出店|しゅってん}した。
examples.english: I set up a stall at the local festival.

examples.japanese: イベントへの{出店|しゅってん}{申|もう}し{込|こ}みは{来月|らいげつ}{締|し}め{切|き}りです。
examples.english: The deadline for applications to set up a booth at the event is next month.

notes:
READING NOTE:
Also read as でみせ when used as a standalone noun meaning "branch store" or "stall" (the store itself, rather than the act of opening one). The reading {出店|しゅってん} emphasizes the action of opening/establishing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新規|しんき}{出店|しゅってん}: new store opening
- {海外|かいがい}{出店|しゅってん}: opening stores overseas
- {出店|しゅってん}{計画|けいかく}: store opening plan
- フリーマーケットに{出店|しゅってん}する: to set up a stall at a flea market
